text: Current CanCompactNow rejects folders with pseudo headers and folders whose offline-operation table has a row. HasPseudoActivity checks the pseudo map count; HasOfflineActivity checks whether its cursor obtains a row. These are separate forms of in-progress IMAP work. Preserve both checks before scheduling this compaction family; neither is a general folder semaphore or universal network-idle test. No pending-operation scenario was executed.
